{{short description|Norwegian businessperson (born 1958)}}

'''Heidi Marie Petersen''' (born 22 March 1958) is a [[Norway|Norwegian]] businessperson.

She was educated with a Master of Science from the [[University of Trondheim]]. She was employed in [[Kværner|Kværner Oil & Gas]] in 1988, moving to [[Rambøll|Rambøll Oil & Gas]] as managing director in 2000. She left in 2007, and is now an independent businesswoman.<ref name=aker>{{cite web|url=http://www.akersolutions.com/Internet/AboutUs/Board+and+Executive+Management/Boardmembers.htm|title=Board members|author=[[Aker Solutions]]|accessdate=2008-11-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080828221625/http://www.akersolutions.com/Internet/AboutUs/Board%2Band%2BExecutive%2BManagement/Boardmembers.htm|archive-date=2008-08-28|url-status=dead}}</ref>

She is the [[chair (official)|chair]] of [[Sandefjord Airport, Torp|Sandefjord Lufthavn AS]] and is a member of the boards of [[Aker Solutions]], [[Norsk Hydro]], [[Ocean Heavy Lift]] and [[Awilco Offshore]].<ref name=aker/>
